lines.en: label iospring1:
scene clearnightsky
I started reading again.
lines.zh: 我又开始阅读了。

lines.en: Not words that I should or words that I’m meant to, but words that make the pain more painful and remind me why I limp when a girl with red hair would rather be the splint I never asked for.
lines.zh: 不是那些我该读的、也不是那些注定要我读的文字，而是那种让痛苦变得更痛的文字——它们提醒我，为什么当那个红头发的女孩宁愿成为那副我从未索取过的夹板时，我却还是一瘸一拐。

lines.en: A blueish glow bleeds out from the screen of my phone, but the vision it carries with it is not one with inflated breasts nor hair in private places, no.
lines.zh: 手机屏幕渗出一抹幽蓝的光，但它承载的画面既没有隆起的乳房，也没有私密处的毛发，不是的。

lines.en: It carries with it, words.
lines.zh: 它承载的，是文字。

lines.en: Words that make the pain more-
lines.zh: 让痛苦变得更痛的文字——

lines.en: You already know.
lines.zh: 你已经知道了。

lines.en: I already told you.
lines.zh: 我已经告诉过你了。

lines.en: This one is particularly relevant. And it goes like this.
lines.zh: 这一首特别应景。它是这样的。

lines.en: {i}It's late. I've come\nto find the flower which blossoms\nlike a saint dying upside down. {/i}
{i}The rose won't do, nor the iris.\nI've come to find the moody one, the shy one,\ndowncast, grave, and isolated.{/i}
{i}Now, blackness gathers in the grass,\nand I am on my hands and knees.\nWhat is its name?{/i}
{i}Little sister, my indigo,\nmy secret, vaginal and sweet, you unfurl yourself shamelessly\ntoward the ground. {/i}
{i}You burn. You live\na while in two worlds at once. {/i}
lines.zh:
{i}你燃烧。你存活，
一时之间同时栖居于两个世界。{/i}

lines.en: This one is called “My Indigo” and it makes me feel a little less alone.
lines.zh: 这一首叫《我的靛蓝》，它让我觉得自己没那么孤单。

lines.en: But the way I’m feeling doesn’t matter now when there’s so much left unfelt.
lines.zh: 但既然还有那么多的感受尚未被感受，我的感受如何也就无所谓了。

lines.en: Like cholera I spread, siphoning the moisture that I’ve come to know as complacency from everything and everyone — leaving a trail of excrement in my wake toward another resting place.
lines.zh: 我像霍乱一样扩散，从万事万物和所有人身上抽走那种我已经熟知的、名为自满的湿气——在我身后留下一路粪便，通往又一个安息之地。

lines.en: To properly spread, I must find water.
lines.zh: 要好好地扩散，我就必须找到水。

lines.en: I hope I can remember how to swim.
lines.zh: 希望我还记得该怎么游泳。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath1
: Hey.
: Long time, no see. How’s the bathhouse holding up?
lines.zh: : 好久不见。澡堂还撑得住吗？

lines.en: scene iobluedeath2
: We’re closed for the night.
lines.zh: : 我们今晚打烊了。

lines.en: : Isn’t it a little early for-
lines.zh: : 现在是不是太早了点——

lines.en: : Sorry for the inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 给您添麻烦了，抱歉。

lines.en: I’ve spread a little faster than normal, I see.
lines.zh: 看来我这次扩散得比平常快了一点。

lines.en: I didn’t even need to enter the water.
lines.zh: 我甚至连水都不用下。

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Io?
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲吗，Io？

lines.en: : Something? No. Everything? Yes. But everything is {i}always{/i} wrong because I’m basically just the human equivalent of a magnet that’s forgone its attraction to metal in place of tragedy.
lines.zh: : 什么事？没有。所有的事？有。不过所有的事{i}一直{/i}都是错的，因为我基本上就是一个人形的磁铁——放弃了对金属的吸引，转而吸引悲剧。

lines.en: : That sounds pretty rough. But hey, if it’s any consolation, I’ve felt more or less the same about myself lately.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺难受的。不过嘿，如果这能算安慰的话，我最近对自己的感觉也差不多。

lines.en: : Mhm.
: That’s it? Not in the mood to talk tonight?
lines.zh: : 就这样？今晚没心情说话？

lines.en: : Mhm.
: Are you mad at me or something?
lines.zh: : 你在生我的气还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene iobluedeath3
: I should be.
lines.zh: : 我应该生气才对。

lines.en: : I should be a lot of things right now. But of course I can’t get a hold of my brain and tell it how to feel because, if I could do that, this wouldn’t be a problem in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我现在本该有很多种感受才对。可我当然没法抓住自己的大脑、告诉它该怎么去感受——因为要是我能办到，这事从一开始就不会成为问题。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath4
: Trash will be trash, right? Is that a phrase? Because if it’s not, it is now. I’m making it a phrase.
lines.zh: : 垃圾就是垃圾，对吧？有这句话吗？如果没有，那现在就有了。我要让它成为一句话。

lines.en: : Then I’ve got one of my own in saying that one man’s trash is another man’s treasure.
lines.zh: : 那我也回敬一句：一个人的垃圾，是另一个人的宝贝。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath5
: Hoarding is a trauma response. I’m not taking that as a compliment. Both because I don’t want to be complimented and because I think I {i}am{/i} mad at you.
lines.zh: : 囤积是一种创伤反应。我可不把这当成夸奖。一来我不想被夸，二来我觉得我{i}确实{/i}在生你的气。

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 生什么气？

lines.en: : Something I don’t want to bring up because I don’t want you to be mad at {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 生一件我不想提起的事的气，因为我不想让你生{i}我{/i}的气。

lines.en: : That’s a little hypocritical, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这有点双标吧，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Have you been away for so long that you’ve already forgotten who you’re talking to right now?
lines.zh: : 你离开这么久，是不是已经忘了现在在跟谁说话了？

lines.en: : Depends. Have {i}you{/i} forgotten how attached to me you’re supposed to be, even when we both know it’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况。{i}你{/i}是不是忘了你本该有多依恋我——即便我们俩心里都清楚那是错的？

lines.en: : I don’t think I ever said it was wrong.
lines.zh: : 我好像从来没说过那是错的。

lines.en: : Well, you’re acting like it’s wrong.
lines.zh: : 可你现在表现得就像那是错的。

lines.en: : Can you just tell me why you’re here so I can come up with some sort of shitty excuse for why it’s a bad time?
lines.zh: : 你能不能直接告诉我你来干什么，好让我编出个蹩脚的借口，说现在时机不对？

lines.en: : Can you look at me?
lines.zh: : 你能看着我吗？

lines.en: scene iobluedeath6
: I don’t know if that’s a good idea...It’ll make me want to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那算不算个好主意……那会让我想要跟你说话。

lines.en: : And if I talk to you, we’ll have to talk about the last few months. Which means we’ll mention things that have changed and things that we’ve learned.
lines.zh: : 而我一跟你说话，我们就得谈起过去这几个月。那就意味着我们会提到那些已经改变了的事，还有我们已经得知的事。

lines.en: : Then, that will naturally progress to you learning that I know a thing I’m not supposed to know and that {i}you...{/i}
lines.zh: : 然后事情自然就会发展到你发现我知道一件我不该知道的事，而{i}你{/i}……

lines.en: : That you may have...{i}heard{/i} something about...someone who might...have stupid green hair or...is named Io...
lines.zh: : 你可能……{i}听说{/i}过一些……关于某个可能……长着蠢绿头发、或者……叫 Io 的人的事……

lines.en: : No one really talks about you, Io.
lines.zh: : 其实没人真的谈论你，Io。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath7
: Huh?
: It’s just hard to hear things about you when no one but Uta brings you up. And I’ve barely seen her lately either.
lines.zh: : 除了 Uta 根本没人提起你，我想听到关于你的事都难。而且我最近也几乎没怎么见她。

lines.en: : So...you {i}haven’t{/i} heard anything then? No rumors...or...{i}anything{/i} at all?
lines.zh: : 所以……你什么都{i}没{/i}听说？没有谣言……或者……{i}任何事{/i}？

lines.en: : None whatsoever. So, about this thing that you’re not supposed to know-
lines.zh: : 一点都没有。那么，关于那件你不该知道的事——

lines.en: scene iobluedeath8
: Sorry, I don’t have any idea what you’re talking about. And we’ve already spent too much of this reunion’s time on a thing I misunderstood. Quite thankfully at that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我完全不知道你在说什么。而且这次重逢已经在这件我误解了的事情上花了太多时间。谢天谢地是误解。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 但是——

lines.en: : Nope! Besides, the thing I know is probably just another misunderstanding anyway. Or at least that’s what I’m going to tell myself so I can slink back into blissful ignorance, as forced as that bliss may be.
lines.zh: : 不！再说了，我知道的那件事大概也只是另一场误会。至少我会这么告诉自己，好让我重新缩回那种极乐的无知里去——尽管那份极乐是被迫的。

lines.en: : But hey, bliss is a thing I’m already used to forcing. Mostly in the form of stuff that comes in translucent orange bottles. But you already know that since it’s the same stuff I almost killed Miku with.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，极乐本来就是我早就习惯去强求的东西。多半是装在半透明橙色药瓶里的那种。不过你已经知道了，因为那东西和我差点害死 Miku 的，是同一种。

lines.en: : I was well aware of it long before she was even involved.
lines.zh: : 早在她卷进来之前，我就已经很清楚这件事了。

lines.en: : Which she’s not anymore, by the way. She doesn’t need me now that she has a thing. Just like you don’t need me now that you have a thing.
lines.zh: : 顺便一提，她现在也不掺和了。她有了「那件事」，就不需要我了。就像你有了「那件事」，也不需要我了一样。

lines.en: : The only {i}thing{/i} I have is an expired lease on life and the desire to lock myself in a padded room for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 我{i}唯一{/i}拥有的，就是一份已经到期的人生租约，以及把自己永远锁进一间软垫病房的渴望。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath9
: Sounds like a better plan than wasting your breath on someone so worthless that her peers won’t even bring her up again after shining the spotlight on her for everyone to see.
lines.zh: : 听起来比把力气浪费在一个毫无价值的人身上要好——那种人就算被聚光灯照亮、摆给所有人看过，她的同龄人也不会再提起她。

lines.en: : You should tell me what happened, Io.
lines.zh: : 你应该告诉我发生了什么，Io。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath10
: I’d rather fall asleep on an active tablesaw!
lines.zh: : 我宁可在正在运转的台锯上睡着！

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: scene iobluedeath8
: Just forget it, Sensei! Let’s seize this opportunity to go back to square one! Or...whatever square it was that we left off on before you went catatonic and I broke into your house.
lines.zh: : 别问了，Sensei！我们不如抓住这个机会，一切回到原点！或者……回到你陷入木僵、而我闯进你家之前的那个原点。

lines.en: : Yeah, about that. You might have noticed back when I met up with you and Miku at the park, but I’m not sure if I can just “go back.”
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到这个。那天你和 Miku 在公园跟我会面的时候你可能已经注意到了，但我不确定我还能不能就这么「回得去」。

lines.en: : And by “not sure,” I quite literally mean that I can not. So there’s a high likelihood that {i}both{/i} of us are going to do nothing but shit all over ourselves in one another’s presence from now on.
lines.zh: : 而我说的「不确定」，字面意思就是回不去。所以从今往后，{i}我们俩{/i}很可能会在彼此面前把一切都弄得一塌糊涂。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath11
: I think this might be the first time I’ve ever been excited to listen to someone whine before.
lines.zh: : 我好像还是头一次这么期待听人发牢骚。

lines.en: : For now, maybe. But there’s a good chance you’ll be the one who winds up getting sick of {i}me{/i} at this rate.
lines.zh: : 现在也许是吧。但照这个势头，到最后厌烦{i}我{/i}的人很可能是你。

lines.en: : Wanna make a bet, then?
lines.zh: : 那要不要打个赌？

lines.en: : Why not? If nothing else, it’ll give us one more paper-thin excuse to stay together.
lines.zh: : 有何不可？反正这又给了我们一个薄如纸的、可以继续待在一起的借口。

lines.en: : Then, I’ll bet you my life that you give up on me before I give up on you.
lines.zh: : 那我赌上我的命——你放弃我，会先于我放弃你。

lines.en: : And I’ll bet you mine that you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 那我也赌上我的命——你错了。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath12
: So we both die either way.
lines.zh: : 所以无论如何我们俩都得死。

lines.en: : Poetic, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 挺有诗意的，不是吗？

lines.en: : A little cringey too, but that’s par for the course when it comes to people like us.
lines.zh: : 也有点让人起鸡皮疙瘩，不过对我们这种人来说，这也是意料之中。

lines.en: scene black
: But hey, this is a reunion! Which means that we should celebrate with greasy food and continued tales of why we hate the world that we were born in!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，这可是重逢啊！那就该用油腻的食物来庆祝，再继续讲讲我们为什么憎恨自己降生的这个世界！

lines.en: : Or fell in love with.
lines.zh: : 或者爱上这个世界。

lines.en: : Hm? Love? This place? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 嗯？爱？这个地方？我不懂。

lines.en: : And I hope you never do.
lines.zh: : 我希望你永远都别懂。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath13

Io and I head over to a fast food restaurant to medicate ourselves with food that would be called poison by most other standards. But, in a sense, poison is just as good as medicine for those who deserve death.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 去了一家快餐店，用按大多数标准都会被称作毒药的食物给自己治病。但从某种意义上说，对那些该死的人来说，毒药和良药也没什么两样。

lines.en: I’m talking about myself in regard to that last part, of course. Shocking, I know. But I don’t think that Io deserves death. Just maybe something along the same lines that Nodoka got after fucking with Yumi.
lines.zh: 我说的最后那部分，当然是指我自己。我知道这很令人震惊。但我不认为 Io 该死。最多也就是 Nodoka 招惹了 Yumi 之后落得的那种下场。

lines.en: She isn’t feeling well, but I’m not sure if she’s always been this way or if it’s just more apparent to me now that I see this same faux-contentment every time I look in the mirror.
lines.zh: 她不太舒服，但我不确定她一直是这样，还是只因为如今我每次照镜子都会看到一模一样的伪装的满足，所以才觉得格外明显。

lines.en: I wonder if it might have something to do with the fact that “something may have happened.” But I concede that whatever that wasn’t doesn’t have anything to do with me since I’m not her teacher anymore.
lines.zh: 我猜这也许跟「可能发生了什么」有关。但我承认，那件并没有发生的事与我无关，毕竟我已经不是她的老师了。

lines.en: I have my life and she has hers. The rest of the girls have {i}theirs{/i} too. And the best way for me to stay involved with them, since I can not tear myself away entirely, is to shed what matters least.
lines.zh: 我有我的人生，她有她的。其他女孩也有{i}她们的{/i}。既然我无法彻底抽身，那对她们最好的参与方式，就是舍弃最不重要的那一部分。

lines.en: It’s okay to have things of your own. It’s okay to hide your problems from the people you don’t want to burden.
lines.zh: 拥有属于自己的东西，没关系。把自己不想拖累的人蒙在鼓里，也没关系。

lines.en: It’s okay to fake a smile while you’re doing that because maybe, just maybe, that smile will help someone.
lines.zh: 这么做的时候假装微笑也没关系，因为也许，只是也许，那个微笑会帮到某个人。

lines.en: So as the two of us, surrounded by smiles in a business that uses them as a marketing tactic, fake our happiness for the sake of one another, I take a bite out of a cheeseburger. But all I taste is flesh.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩，被那些被当成营销手段的微笑包围着，为了彼此假装着自己的幸福，我咬了一口芝士汉堡。可我尝到的只有肉。

lines.en: Flesh and the idea that I, too, have found myself in the mouth of a greater being.
lines.zh: 肉，以及这样一个念头——我也已经落进了某个更巨大的存在的口中。

lines.en: But instead of trying to preserve myself, I just wonder how I must taste.
lines.zh: 但我并没有试图保全自己，只是好奇我尝起来会是什么味道。

lines.en: It must be good if so many chunks of me have been ripped out.
lines.zh: 味道一定不错吧，毕竟我身上已经被撕掉了那么多块。

lines.en: : So...hear any funny jokes lately?
lines.zh: : 那么……最近听到什么好笑的笑话吗？

lines.en: : No. But I {i}did{/i} go camping recently.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过我最近{i}去{/i}露营了。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath14
: Camping?! I want to go camping! Why didn’t you go with me?!
lines.zh: : 露营？！我也想去露营！你为什么没带上我？！

lines.en: : Because I went with a bunch of older women and Ami instead.
lines.zh: : 因为我是跟一帮年纪更大的女人还有 Ami 一起去的。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath15
: Ew. I didn’t like anything about that sentence.
lines.zh: : 恶心。这句话里我一个字都不喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I didn’t invite you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我才没叫你。

lines.en: I conveniently leave out the fact that she didn’t even cross my mind.
lines.zh: 我很识趣地略过了她压根儿没在我脑子里出现过这一点。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath16
: You should go again, but with Uta and me next time. I’ve never gone before, but I’ve always wanted to try.
lines.zh: : 你应该再去一次，不过下次带上我和 Uta。我从没去过，但一直想试试。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad at least {i}you’re{/i} enthusiastic about it since Uta and I would very likely be useless.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少{i}你{/i}对此这么有热情，我很高兴，因为我和 Uta 大概都会很没用。

lines.en: : Uta wouldn’t be useless. She went camping all the time when she was little. She has a crossbow and everything.
lines.zh: : Uta 才不会没用。她小时候经常去露营。她连弩都有。

lines.en: : A crossbow? Exactly how long do you think we’d be camping for to warrant bringing that along?
lines.zh: : 弩？你以为我们要露营多久，才需要把那玩意儿也带上？

lines.en: : Hopefully for the rest of our lives. If the three of us start living off the grid, we can bypass taxes and grow our own food and stuff. It would be true freedom, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 希望是余生。如果我们三个从此脱离电网生活，就能绕过税收，自己种吃的什么的。那就是真正的自由，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’re in high school. You don’t pay taxes.
lines.zh: : 你还在上高中。你不交税。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath17
: I pay taxes when I buy things from the store, which is more than enough to make me know how much they suck and that we’d be better off without them.
lines.zh: : 我从商店买东西的时候就在交税了，这已经足够让我知道税有多讨厌、没有它们我们会过得更好。

lines.en: : Fair enough. But even then, I can’t say I like the idea of living in the woods for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过即便如此，我也说不上喜欢在林子里住一辈子的主意。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath18
: Yeah. It sounds nice in theory, but I wouldn’t be able to charge my power tools or watch baseball anymore, and those two things are basically half of the reasons I have to stay alive.
lines.zh: : 是啊。理论上听起来不错，但那样我就没法给电动工具充电、也没法看棒球了，而这两样基本上就是我活下去的理由的一半。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s four more than I have.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那可比我多了四个。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath19
: Think you’re broken enough to settle for someone like me yet, then? Maybe I could be your first reason if all this sudden trauma has lowered your standards by enough?
lines.zh: : 那么，你已经觉得自己够残破、可以将就我这样的人了吗？也许如果这突如其来的创伤把你的标准拉低得够多，我能成为你的第一个理由？

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say they were high at all since you had no problem consenting to a relationship with that blonde who isn’t blonde anymore. Slight improvement, sure. But still gross.
lines.zh: : 并不是说你的标准本来就高——毕竟你毫不犹豫地就答应了和那个如今已经不金发的金发女交往。算是略有进步吧。但依然恶心。

lines.en: : I’ll take blonde over green any day.
lines.zh: : 金发再怎么样也比绿头发好。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath20
: Smart move. I hear that girls with green hair can be kind of psycho sometimes.
lines.zh: : 明智之选。我听说绿头发的女生有时候挺疯的。

lines.en: : Yeah, they never shut up either.
lines.zh: : 是啊，而且她们还从来闭不上嘴。

lines.en: : They’re probably just so excited whenever someone acknowledges their worthless existence that they-
lines.zh: : 她们大概只是因为终于有人承认了她们那毫无价值的存在，就兴奋得——

lines.en: : Over here. There’s a table open this way.
lines.zh: : 这边。这边有张空桌子。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath21
: Huh?
scene black
scene iobluedeath22
: Can you believe that the ice cream machine is broken {i}again?{/i} Has it {i}ever{/i} worked?
lines.zh: : 你能相信冰淇淋机{i}又{/i}坏了吗？它{i}到底{/i}有没有好过？

lines.en: : Mommy, can we go next door for dessert after dinner? Please?
lines.zh: : 妈妈，我们吃完晚饭能去隔壁吃甜点吗？求你了？

lines.en: scene iobluedeath23
: I don’t know, dear. I’m not sure if all of those calories are good for your health. It’s bad enough that we’re stopping at-
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，亲爱的。我不确定那么多卡路里对你的身体好不好。我们还要在——这已经够糟了。

lines.en: : Daaaaaaad? Pleeeeeeeease?
: Listen to your mother, sweetheart.
lines.zh: : 听你妈妈的话，宝贝。

lines.en: : But Mommy was going to get ice cream for herself! That’s not fair!
lines.zh: : 可是妈妈自己也要买冰淇淋！这不公平！

lines.en: : That’s because Mommy is pregnant and if she doesn’t get what she wants, she’s going to kill all of us.
lines.zh: : 那是因为妈妈怀孕了，要是她得不到想要的东西，她会把我们全杀了。

lines.en: : Mommy will give you a bite of her ice cream when we get home, baby. Now, follow your father so we stop disturbing the other customers.
lines.zh: : 宝贝，回家以后妈妈会让你咬一口她的冰淇淋的。现在，跟上你爸爸，我们别再打扰其他客人了。

lines.en: scene iobluedeath24
: {i}Would you really kill me, Mommy?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}妈妈，你真的会杀了我吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Robert, can you please tell your daughter I’m not actually a murderer?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Robert，你能不能跟你女儿说一声，我不是真的杀人犯？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not until I know for sure.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在我确认之前不行。{/i}

lines.en: : Are you alright, Io?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Io？

lines.en: scene iobluedeath25
: Yeah, I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没事。

lines.en: : Well, now I {i}know{/i} you’re not fine. The Io Ichimonji I know would never miss out on an opportunity to self-deprecate, and I basically just handed you one on a silver platter.
lines.zh: : 好吧，现在我{i}知道{/i}你根本没事了。我认识的那个 Io Ichimonji 绝不会放过任何一个自贬的机会，而我刚刚基本上是把一个机会装在银盘上端给了你。

lines.en: : I just get annoyed when other people interrupt my conversations, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是不喜欢别人打断我的对话，就这样。

lines.en: : They weren’t really-
lines.zh: : 他们其实也不算——

lines.en: : I lost my train of thought. Now I can’t remember what I was talking about and I have to start all over. It’s annoying.
lines.zh: : 我的思路断了。现在我想不起自己刚才在说什么，得从头再来一遍。很烦。

lines.en: : And now they’re being loud...how am I supposed to focus?
lines.zh: : 而且现在他们还那么吵……让我怎么集中注意力？

lines.en: : Io, they’re just eating. They’re not-
lines.zh: : Io，他们只是在吃东西。他们又没有——

lines.en: scene iobluedeath26
: Can we leave?
lines.zh: : 我们能走了吗？

lines.en: : I’m not feeling well all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我突然不太舒服。

lines.en: Io had been tapping her knuckles on the table since we first showed up here.
lines.zh: Io 从我们一到这里开始，就一直在用指节敲桌子。

lines.en: She’s stopped now.
lines.zh: 现在她停下了。

lines.en: It’s like she’s focusing all she has on just maintaining composure and, as unfortunate as it is to say, I get it.
lines.zh: 就好像她把全部力气都用在维持镇定上——虽然这么说很不幸，但我能理解。

lines.en: I don’t have to know {i}why.{/i} And sure, I can guess to sate my own curiosity...But guessing will do nothing other than risk hurting her, and I’m not sure how much more pain that fragile frame of hers can take.
lines.zh: 我不必知道{i}原因{/i}。当然，我可以为了满足自己的好奇心去猜……但猜测除了有可能伤害到她之外毫无用处，而我不确定她那副脆弱的身躯还能承受多少痛苦。

lines.en: : Do you want me to ask if we can take this to go instead? Or-
lines.zh: : 你想让我问问能不能打包带走吗？还是——

lines.en: : I’m not really hungry anymore. I just want to leave. Can we leave? Please?
lines.zh: : 我已经不太饿了。我只想走。我们能走了吗？求你了？

lines.en: : Please?
lines.zh: : 求你了？

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah.
: We can leave.
lines.zh: : 我们可以走了。

lines.en: $ io_love += 1
$ iospring1 = True
jump iospring2
